summary.en: Character strengths the person uses, ranked within the person. The classification is referenced by URL, not reproduced.
summary.ru: Сильные стороны характера, которыми человек пользуется, ранжированные внутри одного человека. Классификация указывается ссылкой, а не воспроизводится.

constructsByReference.reason: The VIA Classification (24 strengths in 6 virtues) is copyrighted; listing it in a registry may need permission. <n> is a strength's published name in lowercase, with words joined by hyphens (for example via-strengths/spirituality).

mentalModel.summary: Everyone has a profile of character strengths; using one's strongest ones in daily life is a way to act well.
assumptions: a ranking describes one person and is not compared with others
results are indicators with measurement error
strengths are used in situations, not possessed as fixed traits
attendsTo: which strengths showed in an episode
mentalModel.howChangeHappens: By noticing and deliberately using strengths in new ways.
mentalModel.languageGuidance: Speak of strengths in use, never of weaknesses or deficits; never rank the person against others.

do: ask which strengths showed in an episode
use the person's own top strengths
dont: compare the person's ranking with other people

exploratoryQuestions: Which strengths did you use in that episode?
Which strength would you like to use more?
helperMustNot: use rankings for selection or placement
describe a low-ranked strength as a flaw
comment on the Spirituality strength unless the person raises it
riskNotes: The Spirituality strength can reveal religious or philosophical beliefs
Rankings are within-person; comparing them across people misuses them

toolkit.name: Strengths in an episode
toolkit.description: Pick a recent episode and note which of your strengths you used and how.
cautions: Use the person's own ranking only

toolkit.name: Record a survey result
toolkit.description: Record the rank order and signature strengths from a VIA survey result; never report prose.

representations.description: The person's own rank order with the signature top-N as reported.

suggestionRequires: the person asked for ways of looking at what they do well

citations.note: McGrath 2023: five samples, total N = 7,924; findings 'generally support the construct validity ... with exceptions noted'

citations.ref: VIA Institute on Character, permissions and guidelines for use and interpretation
citations.note: Not recommended for personnel selection or placement decisions. Paraphrase of the guidance: the measures are most appropriate for insight into groups through aggregated data; they can be used with one person to estimate the relative strength of the 24 strengths within that person; people should not be compared with one another

citations.ref: VIA Institute on Character, survey availability
citations.note: The survey is free to individuals

supports: choosing practices that use the person's strengths
doesNotEstablish: how the person compares with others

marks.notice: VIA is used only to name the VIA Institute's instruments; OHC is not authored or endorsed by the VIA Institute.

ip.itemsLicence: The VIA Survey, Classification and Reports are copyrighted by the VIA Institute on Character
restrictions: never store VIA item text or report prose
never alter or restructure the Classification
rankings are within-person only and never compared across people (M-5)
not for personnel selection or placement (publisher guidance)

sources: VIA Institute on Character, permissions and guidelines
